title: rtl-design result.json contract (schema_version 1)
description: Complete contract for asic/<module>/Design/rtl-design/result.json. Canonical handoff to consumers is via README.md (`Top module: <TOP>` line + SGDC/SDC annotations) and filelist.txt (RTL source list) at the canonical path Design/rtl-design/; stage_specific has no pass-required fields. top_module may be populated for audit/cross-validation but is not consumed by any reader (consumers parse TOP from README.md `Top module:` line first, falling back to filelist.txt first non-comment line). On status=fail, stage_specific.fail_reason is required (if/then below) — the one-line failure narrative.
